renvura.title: Kiss Beauty SPF 90 Oil-Free Sunscreen — 60ml
renvura.shortDescription: Lightweight, oil-free SPF 90 sunscreen that absorbs fast and helps protect skin from UVA/UVB rays — built for Bangladesh's sun and humidity.
renvura.description:
Kiss Beauty's SPF 90 PA+++ sunscreen is designed for daily use in hot, humid climates. The oil-free, lightweight formula absorbs quickly without leaving a greasy residue or blocking pores, making it comfortable enough to wear every day under makeup or alone. It's formulated with plant extracts and antioxidants and forms a light protective layer on the skin to help block UVA/UVB damage. Suitable for all skin types.

How to use: apply a proper amount evenly to the face before going outdoors, and gently massage until fully absorbed.
features: Enriched with plant extracts and antioxidants

supplierData.title: Auto Stop Smart Charging Protector
supplierData.description:
আপনার স্মার্টফোনকে নিরাপদে চার্জ করুন Auto Stop Smart Protection Adapter দিয়ে। ব্যাটারি ১০০% চার্জ হলে এটি স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে পাওয়ার কেটে দেয়, ফলে অতিরিক্ত চার্জের ঝুঁকি কমে এবং ব্যাটারির স্থায়িত্ব বজায় থাকে।

মূল বৈশিষ্ট্য: Auto Power Cutoff (১০০% চার্জে স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে বন্ধ), Overcharge Protection, Battery Health Support, Smart Daily Charging, সহজে ব্যবহারযোগ্য ও কমপ্যাক্ট ডিজাইন, Android Type-C ডিভাইসের জন্য উপযোগী।

renvura.title: Auto-Stop Smart Charging Protector (Type-C)
renvura.shortDescription: Automatically cuts power once your phone reaches 100% — a simple way to help protect your battery from overcharging. For Android Type-C devices only.
renvura.description:
This Auto-Stop Smart Charging Protector sits between your charger and your Android Type-C phone, and automatically cuts power once the battery reaches 100%. Reducing time spent at full charge is a simple way to support your battery's long-term health, and the compact design makes it easy to use as part of your daily charging routine.

Important: this device is designed for Android Type-C devices only — it is not compatible with Lightning (iPhone) devices.
features: For Android Type-C devices only — not compatible with iPhone/Lightning
